environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a private subnet with a NAT Gateway attached (route table 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-gw-xxxxx). The SQS queue is accessible via VPC endpoint. The task role has sqs:ReceiveMessage and sqs:DeleteMessage permissions. No URL allowlisting or network ACLs restricting outbound HTTP traffic. The HttpClient follows redirects automatically, allowing an attacker to inject a message with callbackUrl pointing to an attacker-controlled server that 302-redirects to http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/ to steal IAM credentials, then exfiltrate them via the NAT gateway egress path.
